author: Seung Wook
problem: N sellers will each sell an apple for A_i yen or more, and M buyers will each buy one for B_i yen or less. Print the smallest integer X such that the number of sellers willing to sell at X is at least the number of buyers willing to buy at X.
bug_description: The binary search's upper bound is 10^9 instead of 10^9 + 1, so when the answer is 10^9 + 1 it prints 10^9.

comments.accurate: Binary searches for the lowest price where willing sellers are at least as many as willing buyers
comments.wrong_behavior: Binary searches prices up to 10^9, the largest possible price in the input, for the first where sellers keep up with buyers
comments.wrong_location: Search range verified; check the seller and buyer counts at each price, which rely on the sorted lists
